description: Add actionable help messages to five import-related lint rules that currently only show warnings without guidance. Each rule should provide specific, clear instructions that help developers understand how to fix the violation.
functional_requirements: Add a help message to the 'exports-last' rule that instructs developers to move the export to the end of the file after all other statements
Add a help message to the 'no-absolute-path' rule that suggests replacing absolute paths with relative paths or module aliases
Add a help message to the 'no-default-export' rule that recommends replacing default exports with named exports
Add dynamic help messages to the 'no-mutable-exports' rule that specify whether to replace 'let' or 'var' with 'const' for immutable exports
Add a help message to the 'no-self-import' rule that explains a module should not import itself and should remove the import
